_note: Machine-readable copy of the owner's decision queue. `context/pending_approval.md` is the prose record Simon writes each sweep; this file is the same decisions as rows, so a dashboard can show them without anyone reading the paragraphs. items.headline: The weekly growth check still measures QuarterLine, retired five weeks ago — re-point it at the live products?
items.detail: Measured 2026-10-24: scripts/growth-check.mjs:54 defaults PRODUCT to 'quarterline' (registry status 'killed' since 2026-09-19), so the Friday Growth Watchdog scores a launch gate on a product that no longer exists in the catalogue. The same script had a second, silent defect this sweep — a single un-paginated PostgREST read returned only the OLDEST ~1,000 rows of the whole store, so it reported product_event_rows 0 for spendproof against 1,012 real rows, and unique_sessions_visitor 0 against 2. That truncation is fixed this sweep (explicit .range() paging, a printed events_read_capped when the 200k cap is hit, proven: spendproof 0 -> 1,012 rows / 640 sessions / 2 visitor sessions in 1.7 s). What is left is the scope decision: which products the gate measures and whether it should loop the live inventory. The Growth Watchdog itself queued this ask on 2026-10-23 without a queue row (drift, corrected here).
items.impact: Re-pointing makes the weekly traffic gate measure the products that are actually live, so the visitor leg (unique_sessions_visitor) can be scored at all; silence keeps it reporting on a retired product while six products go unmeasured.

items.headline: One-line fix for the IDE header gap and gutter alignment
items.detail: Done 2026-10-19: the owner's `@Simon fix the header gap` was applied to the shared chrome. Three defects, all measured on the rendered DOM rather than argued from a screenshot: (1) `IdeTextarea`'s header still relied on `justify-between` alone, so at 375 px its badge box overran the bar and painted over the file title (measured −34.0 px on spendproof/caseproof/parcelproof/facturgate); both chrome bars now carry `gap-x-3` + `flex-wrap`, `min-w-0`/`truncate` on the title, `shrink-0` on the badge group, and print only the claim ("ZERO EGRESS") below `sm` with the full label returning at ≥640 px. (2) the Recovery-summary badge on /parcelproof was being squeezed into a two-line pill ("3"/"flags") by the description beside it — `shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap` + `min-w-0` on the text block. (3) `tests/e2e/text-geometry.spec.ts` now measures the chrome BOXES (not glyph runs, and not skipping a clipped title) at 1280 px and 375 px on all four products; proven to bite by reverting the components (−34.0 px, 4 failed) and green with the fix. Gate: tsc, eslint 0 errors, 397/397 unit, build, 96/96 Playwright, visual-QA 24/24. Live: apps.aichieve.net/parcelproof and /caseproof measured after deploy.
items.impact: Closed — the chrome badge never touches the file title at 1280 px or 375 px, and a build-time geometry guard keeps it that way.

items.headline: The factory could not deploy for 20 hours — the new copy gate scanned a folder a clean build does not have; fixed
items.detail: Measured 2026-10-23 15:30Z: Coolify deployments 2544 (2026-10-22 19:06:57Z, commit 533e309) and 2553 (19:16:56Z, commit 5a96e75) both FAILED, and the live container still carries SOURCE_COMMIT 7d60f7e from the 16:37 build, so the FacturGate badge-copy fix in 533e309 never went live. Cause: the new prebuild step copy:check ran vibe-lint.mjs against src AND content/launch_videos; that directory is gitignored runtime output, so in a git clone it does not exist and the linter died with ENOENT scandir '/app/content/launch_videos', exit 1, build failed. Reproduced outside Coolify (git clone . /tmp/cleanclone && npm run copy:check -> same ENOENT), so it was not a platform flake and would have blocked every future product push. Fix applied this sweep in package.json only: copy:check runs the src scan exactly as before, then scans content/launch_videos only when the directory exists, printing an explicit 'not present (gitignored runtime output)' line when it does not. Vendored scripts/vibe/* are untouched (verify-vendor still ok, 2 files match their recorded hash). Proven to still bite: a banned-word sentence injected into src/products/registry.ts in the clean clone returns verdict FAIL, exit 1; reverted.
items.impact: Deploys work again and the copy gate still blocks bad copy in src. Reader-facing launch copy is scanned only on a machine that holds the (gitignored) artifacts, which is where it is generated. Reversal: restore the single combined invocation and make launch copy present in the build (commit the copy, or generate the artifacts in the image).
items.reply: @Simon restore the strict copy gate  (only once launch copy exists in the build)
